solutions.explanation:
Start with the innermost denominator, since each outer fraction needs the value inside it.

The first two stages are
\[
3+\frac13=\frac{10}{3},\qquad
3+\frac{1}{10/3}=3+\frac3{10}=\frac{33}{10}.
\]
The full expression is therefore
\[
3+\frac{1}{33/10}=3+\frac{10}{33}=\boxed{\frac{109}{33}}.
\]
The answer is D. For a nested fraction, work outward from the innermost operation; taking a reciprocal changes both numerator and denominator.
solutions.title: Evaluate the continued fraction from the inside outward.
